subject: Request: Transitional quarterly billing + safeguards for Orion Labs pilot
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Rosenberg <ari@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Piloting Redwood — request for transitional quarterly billing + safeguards

Hi Ari —

Great kickoff yesterday — Orion's integration looks solid and the pilot model is on track. Ari and I discussed Orion's preferred vendor payment rhythm (quarterly invoicing, remit on Net-90 for the first two quarters) to smooth their cash flow during the pilot. They put a PO on file (attached) and asked if Redwood can accommodate a temporary billing cadence for Q1/Q2 of the pilot.

Quick ask to the team: I need an executive approval (finance + deal desk sign-off) to provisionally accept quarterly invoicing with Net-90 terms for the pilot period with the following guardrails: 
- 25% deposit (to be invoiced on SOW signature) to cover initial infra commit
- Monthly usage reporting and a cap of $75k per calendar quarter (auto-rollback to standard monthly invoices if cap is exceeded)
- Rolling credit review after 60 days; Redwood may place account on hold if usage exceeds agreed thresholds or payment is delinquent
- Signed SOW + PO on file (attached) — legal to include express clause limiting extended terms to pilot months only

Rationale: Orion is a high-probability expansion opportunity (strong technical fit, large roadmap potential). Allowing temporary terms helps close this pilot quickly and is materially low-risk with the deposit + cap in place.

Can Marissa or Jonas confirm if finance/executive can greenlight this conditional exception? If approved, I'll ask Legal to add the limited-duration clause and route for signature.

Thanks —
David

--
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ari Rosenberg <ari@orionlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Piloting Redwood — request for transitional quarterly billing + safeguards

David —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attached PO/SOW. A few follow-ups from finance before we can approve: 

1) Deposit amount: are you asking for 25% of the total SOW value or 25% of estimated first-quarter usage? Please confirm number ($).
2) Billing trigger: do you want Redwood to issue one consolidated quarterly invoice (net-90 from invoice date) or quarterly invoices split by monthly usage but with net-90 payment terms? Finance prefers the latter for revenue recognition clarity.
3) Credit control: we need the AP contact and wiring instructions (for the deposit), plus an internal sign-off that Orion's parent entity is the party on the PO.

If we can get the deposit wired upfront and the PO from the correct legal entity, I can provisionally approve the concession for the pilot with the following edits: 
- Limit the concession to 180 days (two quarters) max, auto-revert to standard monthly invoice/net-30 thereafter
- Add a late-fee trigger at 31 days past due (1.5%/month) and right to suspend service at 45 days overdue

Jonas — can you weigh in on commercial risk tolerance? My read is conservative but acceptable with the deposit + cap.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations (Finance)
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ari Rosenberg <ari@orionlabs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Piloting Redwood — request for transitional quarterly billing + safeguards

Marissa —

Thanks — answers inline below and I've attached a redlined SOW with the limited-duration clause and the payment schedule called out.

1) Deposit: 25% of the total SOW value (SOW total = $120,000; deposit = $30,000). We will collect the deposit before onboarding starts and confirm wired receipt to ap@redwood.ai.
2) Billing trigger: Orion requested consolidated quarterly invoice (one invoice per quarter) with net-90. I agree with finance's preference for split monthly detail on the invoice but single remit — we can issue a single quarterly invoice that includes line-itemized monthly usage. That should preserve revenue recognition while matching Orion's remit process.
3) AP details: Orion provided AP contact (Maya Singh, ap@orionlabs.com) and PO number in the attached PDF. Parent entity is Orion Labs, Inc.

Other mitigations: 
- Add an automatic review at day 60 (billing/usage vs cap) and alert to sales & finance
- If usage forecast shows >50% of cap before quarter end, we'll require advance prepayment for the remainder of quarter

If finance is good with the above language and the wiring confirmation, can Jonas please give executive sign-off for the limited pilot concession? If Jonas signs off, I will initiate the redline to Legal and route the SOW for signatures today.

David

--
David Kim
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ari Rosenberg <ari@orionlabs.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Piloting Redwood — request for transitional quarterly billing + safeguards

David / Marissa —

I'm comfortable approving this on the conditions you've laid out. Executive sign-off granted for a time-limited pilot concession: quarterly invoicing with net-90 for up to two quarters, contingent on the following being in place before onboarding completes: 

- $30k deposit cleared (accounting confirmation)
- SOW updated with "pilot-only" clause explicitly reverting to standard terms after 180 days
- Invoice line-itemization by month included in the quarterly invoice for revenue recognition
- Finance to monitor usage weekly and notify Sales at 60 days; Sales to require prepayment if forecasts exceed the cap
- Legal to add suspension and late-fee language Marissa proposed

Marissa — please route any final edits to Legal and AP; Legal, please expect a short redline request from David and loop in Contract Ops for expedited signature. Ari — thanks for the quick turnaround and for providing the PO; we'll confirm deposit wiring and aim to have the pilot onboarding next week.

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
